tests.name: evidence codec round-trip and unknown decoding

cases.title: s7 t1: every evidence value round-trips through the edge-row codec; unknown is the empty value and the others are one distinct byte
s7 t1: an empty value, 0x00 and a byte no value uses decode to unknown; a string that is not a value encodes empty and is reported invalid

titles.title: s7 t1: every evidence value round-trips through the edge-row codec; unknown is the empty value and the others are one distinct byte
s7 t1: an empty value, 0x00 and a byte no value uses decode to unknown; a string that is not a value encodes empty and is reported invalid

cases.title: s7 t2: upsertResolvedRelationsInTxn writes the evidence byte to both edge rows, and a rewrite with another evidence replaces it on both
s7 t2: an evidence that is not a value stores the relationship with an empty value and a warn log; it is not refused
s7 t2: a relationship kept awaiting its target carries its evidence, and promoteResolvedBatch without an evidence stores the carried one; a given evidence wins
s7 t2: an edge returned to pending when its target is removed keeps its evidence, and is promoted again with it
